Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II is probably our 4th Weber gas grill. I really like the design both externally and internally. The interior is set up differently  than the Spirit and seems to drain grease better from what I can tell so far. The ergos outside the grill are great too. From the easy- to-access exposed tank to the sturdy controls, the Spirit II is simple to operate and use. The grill top door is lighter than the Spirit and Genesis models and that almost scared me off, but it seems to be holding up so far. However, overall, we were attracted to the Spirit II and hope to have it for years to come. If it doesn’t meet expectations, I know Weber will stand by the product and so that’s why I keep coming back to this brand.
Results.Title: The lil’ two-burner that can

Results.ReviewText: I am a long time Weber owner. I purchased this model to take advantage of it's slightly smaller size, despite my current 13 year old Weber 3-burner Genesis still working well. I enjoy the quality of the Weber product and will continue to buy from them. This 2 burner model is perfect for everything I want to grill for just my wife and I, but still large enough to accommodate larger meals when company is over. I personally like this side-by-side burner design rather than a front and back in helping control my cook. The smaller area also heats up more quickly than the larger models saving gas and money over time. Lastly, the design allowing the left side table to drop flat means I can fit this grill into a smaller space on the deck.
Results.Title: Great size

Results.ReviewText:
After two successive "house brand" grills from Home Depot and Lowe's both much cheaper than Weber), that failed and repair parts weren't available, we decided to bite the bullet and get a a quality grill with long term support.

We got this one assembled (thank goodness, the instructions are LONG) and fired it up upon arriving home. It heated up quickly (about 10 minutes) and reached 550 degrees, about 200 more than our prior grill. So even before cooking on it, we could see a major difference. 

A couple of nights later, we cooked filets on it, and they came out just like we like them...nicely browned on the outside and rare in the middle. So far we really like this grill and wish we'd done one years ago.
Results.Title: First reputable grill purchase in many years

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
